done_when: A code plan is ready for implementation that, when implemented, can validate collected protected artifact refs against a candidate Git treeish using a Git tree query; accepts only modes `100644` and `100755`; rejects missing paths, directories, submodules, symlinks with mode `120000`, and other non-regular modes; propagates collector invalid-ref failures as candidate validation failures; emits deterministic diagnostics naming the invalid path, cause, mode when present, and owner provenance; and includes validator-boundary tests for FR-001-9 through FR-001-11 plus the path/mode classification and diagnostic portions that support FR-001-8, AC-001-7, AC-001-8, and AC-001-16.
scope: Plan the code changes that add a Git tree path query for candidate treeish validation, validate collected artifact refs against candidate Git object modes, require regular file modes `100644` or `100755`, reject missing paths and non-regular modes, and produce deterministic owner-aware diagnostics. Out of scope: `MergeWorktree` hook wiring, latest-state reads per invocation, second-snapshot confirmation, CAS retry behavior, and post-merge rollback behavior.

desc: MergeWorktree Artifact Guard Freshness And Backstop
done_when: A code plan is ready for implementation that, when implemented, makes `MergeWorktree` pass an artifact guard hook into `performCASMerge`; the hook reads fresh state on every invocation, validates that snapshot's protected refs against the provided candidate treeish, re-reads state and revalidates the same candidate after any candidate-tree failure, returns success when the second snapshot no longer protects the failing path and validates, fails closed with a composite diagnostic when confirmation state cannot be read, and leaves the post-merge `ValidateArtifactRefs` rollback backstop in place; tests cover FR-001-8, FR-001-12 through FR-001-16, FR-001-28, AC-001-1 through AC-001-10, AC-001-15, and AC-001-16 at the `MergeWorktree`/pre-update guard boundary.
scope: Plan the code changes that wire the candidate artifact validator into `MergeWorktree` through the `performCASMerge` pre-update hook, read the latest state for each hook invocation, collect refs from that snapshot, confirm candidate validation failures with one second state snapshot against the same candidate treeish, fail closed when confirmation state cannot be re-read, and retain the post-merge `ValidateArtifactRefs` backstop. Out of scope: collector normalization/provenance internals, the `performCASMerge` hook contract mechanics already covered by `architecture-2`, and submit-for-review diagnostics.
